title: Soul Feast #69: GUIDELINES 3: Pay Attention to My Emotions
excerpt: Your emotions are messages from your soul.
bodyHtml:
Your emotions are messages from your soul. Learn How to Tune In and Listen Here.

In this Soul Feast, Gary Zukav continues the exploration of the Authentic Power Guidelines by introducing the next essential practice: Pay attention to your emotions. He explains that personal transformation does not begin with changing the world around you – that is the illusion of external power. It begins with turning your attention inward.

Emotional pain is not created by events or people; it is a sacred mirror revealing inner dynamics and frightened parts of your personality that are asking for your awareness. 

When you look inside instead of outside, you begin to see how Authentic Power is created.

Gary Zukav describes emotions as messages from the Soul. They show you exactly whether you are experiencing fear or love, and they do this through physical sensations in the body. Instead of judging emotions as “good” or “bad,” Gary Zukav invites you to become emotionally aware by noticing sensations such as pressure, aching, churning, or contraction in specific energy-processing centers. This is how the frightened parts of the personality are recognized and felt instead of being acted out unconsciously.

As you practice Emotional Awareness, you gain the discernment to distinguish between external power and Authentic Power. Choices made from fear create pain, while choices made from love create meaning, trust, and fulfillment. As your awareness grows, the parts of the personality that block love lose their ability to control your life. What has always been present beneath the fear – the loving parts of your soul – becomes visible. This is the essence of spiritual development: the transformation of fear into love, one conscious choice at a time.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

(00:02) — Why focusing on what you can learn about yourself is essential to creating authentic power


(01:13) — How real change happens by looking inside rather than seeking answers in the outside world


(02:58) — Why emotions are messengers from the soul, not reactions caused by others


(06:05) — How physical sensations reveal frightened parts of the personality


(12:17) — The difference between fear and love, and how attachments create emotional pain


(14:43) — How awareness of emotions supports spiritual growth and human evolution

Embrace the Soul Step Challenge

Take out a notebook and begin tracking your emotional experiences throughout the week. Each time you remember, write down the physical sensations you notice in your energy processing centers rather than labeling emotions as “good” or “bad.” Also note when you forget to observe yourself. Without judgment, allow this practice to increase awareness of when fear is present and when a loving choice is possible. This attention to inner experience is how authentic power is developed, moment by moment.
